Title: Public Preview: Data sharing lineage and search for Azure Storage in Microsoft Purview

Body.Content:
Data Sharing Lineage is now available in Microsoft Purview for Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) Gen2 and Azure Blob (Blob) Storage in public preview.

Data Sharing Lineage is aimed to provide detailed information to data producers and data consumers for root cause analysis and impact analysis on their shared data. Data officers can see a list of all datasets that are bi-directionally shared with their partner organizations.

With Catalog integration, data providers and data consumers can now discover sent share and received share assets in the Microsoft Purview Catalog and see the Data Sharing Lineage for those share assets.

Storage in-place sharing public preview is available in Microsoft Purview for Storage accounts in Canada Central, Canada East, UK South, UK West, Australia East, Japan East, Korea South, and South Africa North Azure regions.

Learn more

  • Read the Microsoft Tech Community blog to learn more about how the Data Sharing Lineage works in Microsoft Purview and how organizations can leverage this capability.

  • Get started with How to share data and How to receive share documentation.
